actions.action: Slide the plant out of the pot and inspect the root ball and roots
If the core is dry and roots are healthy, bottom-soak the pot in a sink for 45 minutes, then drain and empty the saucer
If roots are brown or mushy, trim them with alcohol-wiped scissors and repot into fresh potting mix in a draining pot
Pull off fully collapsed or yellowing stems at the base

reason: The answer offers a dry root ball as one of two possibilities alongside root rot, and wrongly assumes watering failed; its soak fix would work but sits behind an unpotting check, while the root-rot branch is safeguarded by inspecting the roots first.
